shared_elements: repeated figures arranged in a row along a band
radiating or fan-like motif (rosette vs. splayed rays)
justification: Both surfaces organise content into horizontal registers with repeated figures processing along a band, and both include a radiating fan-like motif (a carved rosette in A, splayed rays in B), but these are generic organisational devices. A shows a large human figure in fine low relief with dense textured garments, closely worked patterned fields and detailed hands, while B shows sparse, flat, silhouetted quadrupeds and stick-like human limbs with no internal detail; the depicted subjects and conventions of rendering are essentially unrelated.
